reviews.review: Janky and unpolished game. received it in a bundle and I still feel ripped off.

Steam needs an "Eh" Review category. This game prides itself on being made from the Lead of L4D1/2. You can feel the same elements. Gun types, Zombie types, 4 player co-op bit, hordes, "horde ai" and such.

Now I've had my eye on it for a while, so I know its been getting lots of love from devs. It's got a workshop meaning even if dev keeled over, community could easily make sweet love to the game in absence. It's a groovy sci-fi aesthetic. Got perks to up replayability, multiple pathways in levels that you could go through the few I played already.

Buuuut. Sounds are lackluster, guns don't have any oomf to them, heavy guns don't have oomf, first few hordes I didn't even hear the sound cue/music for it. When I was wandering around there wasn't music, just the sound aesthetic of a ship of zombies which was neat but no music for your groovy wandering? No explanation of anything going on at ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ all, like I thought I had a bug when the screen dimmed for a good minute?? No it was a zombie type named "Flasher" which got stuck behind a wall, which is basically a mini sun that blinds you with super bright light and dimming everything else.

Give it a while, the devs keep giving it love I can bet it'll be a wonderful game. As of right now though, if ya want horde shooter like l4d, just stay with l4d
Even Back 4 Blood is better than this.
Its a half baked Left 4 Dead mod with a weird AI generated feel for 20 dollars. My friend and I got it for 1 dollar and it still didn't make the game enjoyable. Don't bother.
